transcript.answer: It is composed in `prFooter()` in `libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts`. `prFooter()` always emits `Lore-Task: <uuid>`. When the task has a real issue number, it also adds `Closes #N`. An undefined or 0 issue number counts as no issue. An earlier version of the spec put this function at `agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts`, but the current CLAUDE.md and tests point to the shared library. Callers such as the `open-pr` stations (for example `apps/stations/src/onboard/open-pr/`) use it to build the pull request body. I did not open the source file itself, so this rests on the docs and tests.
